sourceText:
Garlic Crisp
By: Stacey
Published: Monday, October 11, 2010 - 6:29pm

Ingredients




1 package of refrigerated pizza crust
1 tablespoon olive oil
3 cloves of garlic minced**try 2 the 1st time...it is very garlicky**
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese grated
1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1 tablespoon fresh parsley minced
salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Roll the pizza crust out according to packaged directions.  Drizzle olive oil on top of the crust.  Spread the garlic then sprinkle the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper, cheeses and parsely over the crust. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes...Cut and eat!
